description: This file defines various data transfer objects (DTOs) and request classes related to asset management in a backend system. It includes records and classes for representing asset data, creation requests, update requests, and query parameters, along with code annotations for validation.

classes.name: CreateAssetRequest
classes.description: Request payload for creating an asset, containing necessary asset details and audit fields.

classes.name: UpdateAssetRequest
classes.description: Request payload for updating an asset, similar to creation but with some immutable fields.

classes.name: QueryAssetsRequest
classes.description: Contains optional filtering parameters for querying assets with pagination.
